result.brief: 提出文本世界状态上的结构化推理多步转移模型，用预测增益目标与中间预测奖励监督长时程演化，提升长时程预测与反事实动作敏感性。
result.reason: Textual world model with structured reasoning over state changes; no video/multimodal or visual representation contribution, but world-model dynamics and intermediate state supervision are conceptually adjacent.
